rationale: The plan correctly treats the TPM-only delivery as a deconvolution problem, feeds linear TPM to EPIC and quanTIseq, keeps log2(TPM+1) confined to the QC ordination, keeps sample_01 with an explicit flag and a sensitivity check, and sets condition with control as reference and treated_vs_control as the named contrast with BH across cell-type tests at 0.05. Weaknesses: the between-group test is a limma moderated t on fractions/scores (pooling variance across cell types of different scales within a method is questionable versus the reference's plain Wilcoxon or t-test), the difference of group means is not stated as a reported effect beside the adjusted p, the QC does not report the share of each method's signature genes present in the 12000-gene matrix, and the report omits the stacked bar of fractions per sample. Multi-method consensus and tissue-reference caveats are well handled; enrichment is correctly omitted.
